description: (Na)₂LiBiI₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiBiI₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiBiI₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form LiI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-I bond lengths are 2.93 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form BiI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-I bond lengths are 3.06 Å. I is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Bi atom.
